[[Yoshiki Kuwabara]] (''Geed'', Chimeraberus and Atrocious) |Designer(s) = [[Masayuki Gotoh]] }} {{Nihongo|'''Ultraman Belial'''|ウルトラマンベリアル|Urutoraman Beriaru}} was an evil Ultraman from the [[Land of Light]], who was best known as [[Ultraman Zero]]'s arch enemy and the father of [[Ultraman Geed (character)|Ultraman Geed]]. He was once a great fighter who took part in the [[Ultimate Wars]], but his pride and greed got the better of him. This ultimately led him to commit the heinous crime of attempting to steal the [[Plasma Spark]], for which he was banished. Injured and cast out, Belial was approached and transformed by [[Alien Reiblood]] into a Reionics, forever turning him to the darkness. Belial seemingly met his final end at the hands of Geed, in a climactic final battle that decided the fate of [[World of Side Space|the universe]]. However, his essence still lives on; his existence continues to send ripples through the [[multiverse]] in the form of the [[Belial Factor#Ultraman Z|Devil Splinter]]s derived from his cells, as well as a [[Ultraman Belial (Parallel Isotope)|parallel version]] of himself who lives on in the present day, having had his fate forever changed by a chance encounter with [[Absolute Tartarus]]. Subtitles: *Kaiser Belial: {{Nihongo|Galactic Emperorhttps://tsuburaya-prod.com/encyclopedia/kaiser-belial|銀河大帝|Ginga Taitei}} *Arch Belial: {{Nihongo|Great Galactic Emperorhttps://tsuburaya-prod.com/encyclopedia/arch-belial|超銀河大帝|Chō Ginga Taitei}} *Kaiser Darkness: {{Nihongo|Dark Great Emperor|暗黒大皇帝|Ankoku Dai Kōtei}} *Chimeraberus: {{Nihongo|Belial Fusion Monster|ベリアル融合獣|Beriaru Yūgō-jū}} ==Conception== ===Etymology=== Belial is named after one of the personifications of the Devil. His name is also a synonym used for Satan, which means corrupted gain. ===Design=== Ultraman Belial's current form is designed by [[Masayuki Gotoh]] at the same time as [[Ultraman Zero]], with both of their suits were also manufactured through 3D processing. His main design motif is the shark, which was proposed by then Tsuburaya-affiliated producer Junya Okabe. In addition, his body posture hunching forward is also suggested by Sakamoto to provide the dark Ultra with the presence of a villain at first sight.https://web.archive.org/web/20200921092415/http://eiganavi.entermeitele.net/news/2009/12/post-db75.html In the concept art for ''Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie'', Masayuki Gotoh originally envisioned Belial calling upon the {{Nihongo|'''Belial Sword'''|ベリアルソード|Beriaru Sōdo}} and creating a vortex of darkness with the Giga Battlenizer that would draw in the spirits of Kaiju in the Monster Graveyard to form Belyudra.''Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie'' Super Complete Works, p.71 His other forms' design are as follows: *Early Style: There was no design drawing for Early Style, as the production team simply did a reverse calculation to emphasize the evil Ultra's transformation into villainy. Hence, the Early Style shares the positioning of its red markings with Belial's present self. The suit was made by modifying [[Ultraman Zearth (character)|Ultraman Zearth]]'s suit.https://x.com/aws49T8EvYnPX7U/status/1244777568407969793 *Kaiser Belial: In the design planning, he was tentatively labelled as {{nihongo|'''Scarface Belial'''|スカーフェイスベリアル|Sukāfeisu Beiraru}}. For his returning appearance in ''Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial'', Belial was originally intended to be designed as wearing a set of armor or having a cybernetic arm, until it was decided to simply giving the suit a set of elongated claws (Kaiser Belial Claws) and a scar on his face. Other modifications include a new mask to incorporate said scar and the original suit modified to better fit the suit actor's neck. The red claws were suggestions under Yuichi Abe, while suit actor Hiroshi Suenaga mentioned that the Belial Mantle is the hardest part of the suit, due to its weight of 10 kg. Said cloak even has several orb-like ornaments around the collar, which is a reference to the eponymous [[Wikipedia:Predator (fictitious species)|Predator]] collecting skulls of their victims, in Belial's case, giving the impression that he killed Ultras and taking their [[Color Timer]]s as his prizes. *Arch Belial: In the design planning, he was tentatively called as {{nihongo|'''Tyrant Belial'''|タイラントベリアル|Tairanto Beriaru}}. Since all the villains in the movie are either robots or humanoid, Belial's final form is designed to resemble a monster, but due to designing his form very late, the finalized suit is presented as fragile on the set, forcing the staff members to cautiously maintaining it during the filming. *Chimeraberus: Although a Belial Fusion Monster, Gotoh was ordered to not design Chimeraberus with the image of its corresponding Kaiju Capsule components (Zog and Five King). Instead, Chimeraberus is based on the image of a miniaturized [[Belyudra]] and is even represented as a half humanoid/monstrous creature under [[Koichi Sakamoto]]'s suggestion. *Atrocious: The final form of Ultraman Belial, which represents his standing as the final villain in ''Ultraman Geed''. Like the case of Chimeraberus above, Atrocious has no corresponding image to any of his Kaiju Capsule components and is designed based on a rejected draft of Ultraman Geed's base form, Primitive. His hunching forward posture is removed for an upright standing position that gives off an image closer to a normal Ultraman. Additionally, this is also to make sure that the final episode centers around the idea of Ultraman versus Ultraman, since past series like ''Ultraman X'' and ''Orb'' introduce monstrous creatures as their final opponents. ==History== ===Past=== {{#tag:tabber| 1= {{Quote|However, in our long history, there was just one of us who yielded to the temptation of power. He had youth and strength. However, seeking for even more power, he tried to take all the [[Plasma Spark]] energy for himself. He was exiled from the Land of Light, and vanished far out in the universe. That's right. That was how Belial, the Dark Ultra Warrior, was born.|[[Mirai Hibino]]'s narration}} {{!}}-{{!}} 2= {{Quote|Power... I want power! I'll go beyond them... beyond everyone who looked down on me!|Belial's monologue in his past}} }} [[File:IMG_1394.jpeg|thumb|left|Belial tries to touch the Plasma Spark]] Long ago, Ultraman Belial was a great Ultra Warrior, and a comrade of [[Father of Ultra|Ultraman Ken]]. The two fought together in the [[Ultimate Wars]] against [[Alien Empera]], who impressed Belial with his power. Belial came across [[Mother of Ultra|Ultrawoman Marie]] during the war and held romantic interest in her. He was present to witness Ken's duel with Empera away using the [[Ultimate Blade]]. Afterwards, when Ken was elevated to the position of the [[Inter Galactic Defense Force]]'s Top Commander instead of himself, Belial was consumed with envy and a wounded pride leading to him to eventually decided to attempt to siphon energy from the [[Plasma Spark]] to obtain more power. When he had the chance, he went to the Plasma Spark Tower and was about to grab the Plasma Spark's core, but the light emanating from it was too strong for him to resist. He started screaming in agony and pain because of the light's power. Belial would be banished escorted away from the land of light by Ken a few other Ultra warriors as he continued to writhed in agony. Despite his accomplishments in the Ultimate Wars, he was exiled from the Land of Light for his action were an act was against the planet's highest safety regulations. [[File:27042369-D4A6-468C-B8D2-B46B02DD275F.jpeg|thumb|Belial after his merger with Alien Reiblood]] He eventually landed on a planet similar to the moon, where [[Alien Reiblood]] appeared and corrupted the Ultra Warrior into a Reionics by infusing him with his genes, fully cementing Belial as the all-powerful, evil Ultraman he was best known for. Bestowed with the [[Giga Battlenizer]] and with his army of [[Belial Army|100 monsters]], he [[Revolt of Belial|attacked]] the Land of Light for revenge, all the while he was receiving orders from Reiblood to destroy the Ultras once and for all and conquer the universe. During the rampage he encountered and defeated Zoffy, [[Mother of Ultra|Marie]] and Ken, but [[Ultraman King]] appeared, disarming him and denouncing him and his actions King sealed him away, imprisoning him in the core of the Space Prison which he formed around Belial, which became a moon for the Land of Light. Ultraman King then sealed the Giga Battlenizer in the Valley of Flames. ===Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie=== |-|1= {{Quote|The Dark Ultra Warrior, imprisoned for thousand of years. I am now bringing you back to life [...] Belial... Ultraman Belial. The most evil Ultraman from the Land of Light. You will rule this universe with me. Here's the Giga Battlenizer. It was sealed in the Valley of Flames when you were imprisoned. Take it. (Belial claims the Giga Battlenizer) It's done at last. Now the universe is ours.|Alien Zarab before his death.}} |-|2= {{Quote|I have returned!|Belial after coming back to the Land of Light}} [[File:IMG_1036.jpeg|thumb|left|Belial after being freed]] Many years later he was freed by an [[Alien Zarab]] who gave him back his Giga Battlenizer in hopes of the two forming an alliance. Instead, Belial betrayed and killed Zarab and is attacked by [[Ultraman Taro (character)|Ultraman Taro]] and a group of Ultra Warriors. Defeating all except Taro, the two fell towards the Land of Light. Standing up to reveal a defeated Taro, [[Second Battle of the Land of Light in Nebula M78|he began to attack the other Ultramen]]. While fighting and defeating almost all of the Ultra heroes, he went inside the [[Land of Light|Plasma Spark Tower]], defeating the last wave of heroes and started to fight [[Father of Ultra]]. During the fight, Father of Ultra was initially defeating Belial, but Belial attacked him with the Giga Battlenizer on the scar he gained when he fought with Alien Empera, hurting him and defeated him, later [[Mother of Ultra]] attacked him but Belial withstood her attacks and violently defeated her as well. Belial was about to kill both Ken and Marie, but when he fired his beam, Taro appeared and risked his life to save his parents. Belial didn't kill them, but he took away the Plasma Spark, leaving the planet dark, and every Ultra Warrior was left helplessly frozen being (except for [[Ultraman (character)|Ultraman]], [[Ultraseven (character)|Ultraseven]] and Mebius), with only a bit of light being saved by Taro. Ultraman Belial arrived at the [[Monster Graveyard]], where he used the Plasma Spark to revive his entire army of monsters, forming the [[Belial Army]]. As the survivors of his attack arrived, Belial was surprised to see the Ultra Brothers, but he was more surprised when he saw Rei. After the young Reionics refused an offer to join him, Belial released his entire army at once. Having weakened the Ultras, Belial brainwashed both Rei and his Gomora against their own comrades until [[ZAP SPACY (Zata Astromical Pioneers SPACY)|ZAP SPACY]] arrives with [[Ultraman Dyna (character)|Ultraman Dyna]], and Belial starts to fight with Dyna. Seeing how the team freed Rei, Belial tried to eliminate them but Seven shielded them and sent his Eye Slugger in the last resort tactic. [[File:IMG_1037.jpeg|thumb|Belial apparently surviving Belyudra's destruction]] As Seven collapses, a strange figure dashed in and rescued him. Responding to Belial's question, the Ultra, filled with anger at the death of his father, revealed himself to be [[Ultraman Zero]] and proceeded to finish off the remaining monsters easily. He started to fight Belial, disarming him and throwing away his Giga Battlenizer, leaving Belial in a weakened state, and defeated him, throwing him to the lake of fire in the Graveyard. However, an earthquake occurred, and the souls of the monsters and Belial combined into [[Belyudra]]. The Ultras started fighting him, and after Zero was chosen by the light and given a new weapon, he went directly, supported by the Ultra Brothers, and slashed Belial with the Twin Zero Sword and defeated him. Belial declared he would return and Zero responded that he would be waiting. Belial vanished and the monster exploded, finishing Belial's reign of terror. Sometime later, on a huge rock located in an unknown region of space, Belial's corpse was seen, apparently dead, but his eye suddenly lit up with light. {{Storylink|Mega Monster Battle Ultra Galaxy: The Movie}} ===Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial=== {{#tag:tabber| 1={{Quote|We finally meet. I congratulate you for defeating the Darklops. It hurts. My scar still hurts."
"Belial!"
"Look, you gave me this scar, Ultraman Zero!|Belial and "[[Run]]".}} {{!}}-{{!}} 2={{quote|[[Ultraman Zero|ZERO]]!!!!!|Arch Belial's last word}} }}[[File:Kaiser_Belial_Claws_vs_Zero_Sluggers.jpeg|thumb|left|Belial vs Zero]] In this film, Belial returned as his alias Galactic Emperor Kaiser Belial, forming the [[Belial Galactic Empire]] and controlling a new army of robotic soldiers with his two new allies, [[Darkgone]] and [[Iaron]]. Using the giant spaceship [[Malebrandes]], Belial and his forces conquered the world Esmeralda in another universe and enslaved its protector, [[Mirror Knight]]. With the planet's massive supply of emeralds, which have the ability to be converted into raw energy, Belial planned to use them for his conquest of the universe, starting by destroying the Land of Light. Belial eventually clashes with [[Ultraman Zero]] and later fled to absorb the mass quantities of emeralds he had harvested from Esmeralda (as well as possibly the rest of the universe,) converting it into pure raw energy as a last ditch effort to kill Ultraman Zero and his friends. [[File:IMG_1034.jpeg|thumb|Belial tries to destroy Esmeralda but prevented by [[Ultimate Force Zero]].]] Emerging from the centre of Malebrandes as it detached from Esmeralda, Arch Belial held Zero in his gigantic hand and attempted to crush him. [[Mirror Knight]] and [[Jean-Bot]] arrived and attempted a sequence of hit and run attacks, but Belial simply shrugged these attacks off. Fortunately, [[Glenfire]] reappeared and rescued Ultraman Zero from Arch Belial's grasp, while bringing with him fleets of ships from planets that Belial's forces had ravaged before. Arch Belial however refused to let Zero and his friends win and so attempted to destroy Esmeralda with his Arc Deathcium Beam, forcing the team to create a massive shield to stop the beam from destroying the planet, which though successful exhausted Zero's energy to such an extent that he was on the brink of death. The situation seemed bleak; Zero was on the verge of falling to his titanic adversary, and without him, the others wouldn't be able to defend against another attempt at destroying the planet. However, with the hopes of everyone who was battling against Belial's forces praying for Zero's success, Zero was revived by [[Ultraman Noa]] and thus empowered into becoming [[Ultraman Zero|Ultimate Zero]]. Arch Belial was no match for Ultimate Zero's near-omnipotent power and was defeated by Zero's Final Ultimate Zero attack impaling him through the chest killing him for good. {{Storylink|Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial}} ===Ultra Zero Fight=== {{Quote|I am Zero, but not the same Zero. I will call myself Zero Darkness."
"This wave energy. You must be..."
"You're guessing right, Mirror Knight. I recall that you have once been my servant."
"You must be Belial.|Belial ([[Ultraman Zero Darkness|Zero Darkness]]) and Mirror Knight.}} [[File:StrongCoronaZeroVsKaiserDarkness.jpeg|thumb|left|Belial vs Strong-Corona Zero as Kaiser Darkness]] Belial was killed by the attack from Ultimate Zero, and for some time as the [[Ultimate Force Zero]] mopped up the remains of his former empire. He was cast into the Monster Graveyard and at some point in time, he encountered and combined with the [[Armored Darkness]], being resurrected by its power and becoming '''Kaiser Darkness''', the armor's nature keeping his grudge against his own people strong. He then gathered several powerful aliens, whose species were great rivals to the Ultras and formed the [[Darkness Five]] for the sole purpose of destroying Ultimate Force Zero. After confronting Zero, Belial removed his helmet, much to Zero's shock. The two entered battle, with Zero using Strong-Corona and Ultimate Zero in an effort to subdue Belial. The young Ultra Warrior charged towards Belial but once Zero plunged his sword into his chest. Belial seemingly died, with the empty pieces of Armored Darkness scattering about the impromptu arena, but as Zero prepared to leave, he was caught off-guard by Belial's spirit, who overpowered Zero and forcibly fused with him, creating the [[:Category:Fusions|Fusion Ultra]] [[Ultraman Zero Darkness]]. Zero Darkness then ambushed the Ultimate Force Zero, defeating and killing each of the heroes effortlessly, all while Zero's soul was forced to watch from within the fusion's body. [[File:Dark zero.jpg|thumb|Ultraman Belial as Zero Darkness]] With victory in his grasp, Zero Darkness then invited the rest of the Darkness Five and [[Tyrant]] to conquer the universe. Spotting a defenseless Pigmon, Zero Darkness tried to kill him until his body froze, revealing to be the work of Zero, who fought Belial in an internal conflict over his body. Transforming into a new and extremely powerful form known as Shining Ultraman Zero, the silver Ultraman reprimanded Belial for not being a true Ultraman before exorcising his spirit from his body. Now in full control over himself once more, Zero used his new Shining form to unleash the Shining Star Drive, which began to turn back time in the local area to revive the Ultimate Force Zero. Bombarded by an incredible amount of light, Belial's spirit seemingly burned away into nothingness. Unbeknownst to anyone, though Zero's reversal of the flow of time had revived his friends, it had the unintentional side effect of reviving Belial too, as every incident in the chain of events from Zero's possession to Belial's defeat had been reversed. After realising he was alive once again, Belial vowed to become even stronger than Zero. {{Storylink|Ultra Zero Fight}} ===Ultraman Ginga S The Movie: Showdown! The 10 Ultra Warriors!=== [[File:Belial_(Eteldummy).png|thumb|left|An Eteldummy copy of Ultraman Belial]] Although Belial himself didn't physically appear, [[Etelgar]] created an [[Eteldummy]] version of him that was stationed on the fourth floor. He fights [[Ultraman Zero]], but was defeated by Zero after the young Ultra Warrior used his Mode Changes, followed by Shining Ultraman Zero's Shining Emerium Slash, which sent him to the first floor before exploding. {{Storylink|Ultraman Ginga S The Movie: Showdown! The 10 Ultra Warriors!}} ===Ultraman Orb=== Belial reappeared in the series ''[[Ultraman Orb (series)|Ultraman Orb]]'' as an [[Ultra Fusion Cards|Ultra Fusion Card]] owned by [[Alien Mefilas]] [[Nostra]], who planned to use it as an "ultimate last resort" before [[Jugglus Juggler]] claimed it after murdering him. Alongside the six Lord Monsters, they unsealed Zoffy's card to release [[Maga-Orochi]]. The Ultra Fusion Cards were later retrieved by [[Princess Tamayura]], who gives them to [[Gai Kurenai]] as a countermeasure on [[Maga-Orochi]]. Gai attempted to use the new cards, but Belial kept rejecting him until the Lord Monster broke the princess' barrier, seemingly killing her in the process. Because of Gai's anger at the princess' demise, Belial finally accepted him and allowed the transformation into the new form: Thunder Breastar. With this form, [[Ultraman Orb (character)|Ultraman Orb]] single-handedly defeated the Lord Monster and avenged the princess. {{Storylink|The Dark King's Blessing}} [[File:OrbUltraSupremeCalibur.png|thumb|Belial and other projections of Ultra Fusion Cards aiding Orb.]] Later, his dark power was controlled by Gai when he was fighting Zeppandon in his Thunder Breastar form and eventually swapped into his Orb Origin form. In his later appearances, Belial's power was subjugated and Orb was no longer a violent berserker. He later manifested in the real world via his [[Ultra Fusion Cards|Ultra Fusion Card]] to help Orb finish off the Ultimate Lord Monster, [[Maga-Orochi|Magatano-Orochi]], by firing his Deathcium Beam. {{Storylink|The Wandering Sun}} ===Ultra Fight Orb=== Although he has not physically appeared in this mini-series, Belial was mentioned by Zero after he first met Reibatos and sensed the same aura from him (Reionics). Reibatos later tried to revive Belial after his presumed death, but realized that he was alive. However, in the final episode of ''Ultraman Geed'', it was revealed to be Belial who killed Reibatos, instead of Geed. {{Storylink|Ultra Fight Orb}} ===Pre-Ultraman Geed=== {{Quote|I'm fully revived now! The time has come to get revenge on those fools in the Land of Light!|Belial, while gazing towards the [[Super-dimensional Eradication Bomb]]}} [[File:BelialVSReibatos.png|thumb|left|Belial kills Reibatos]] Having revived from Zero's Shining Star Drive, Belial used this opportunity to formulate his recent scheme, going as far as to reclaim his Giga Battlenizer and [[Ultra Fight Orb|killed]] [[Reibatos]]. Later, he found [[Kei Fukuide]] on a nearly destroyed [[Planet Sturm]], and gave him a place alongside the Darkness Five as one of his followers, giving him a purpose to exist. Belial, along with the Darkness Five, Kei and his new army called {{Nihongo|'''Terror The Belial'''|テラー・ザ・ベリアル|Terā Za Beriaru}}, fought against the Ultra Warriors in a heated battle called the [[Omega Armageddon]], which held the fate of the [[World of Side Space]] at stake.''Ultraman Geed Super Complete Works'', pg 18 With the [[Super-dimensional Eradication Bomb]], Belial triggered [[Crisis Impact]] and turned Earth into its epicenter and would have succeeded in his operation if not for Ultraman King's intervention. As a result of the explosion, Belial was believed to be lost but had sent his servant, Kei, to steal the [[Ultra Capsules]] and [[Riser]]s from the Land of Light, as well as providing the latter his [[Belial Factor#Ultraman Geed|genetic material]] to create his own son [[Riku Asakura]]. Using the stolen capsules as a template, they then created the [[Kaiju Capsules]]. During this time he retreated to a pocket dimension, to hide and recover from his injuries. ===Ultraman Geed=== ====Belial's Plot==== [[File:IMG 1101.jpg|thumb|Belial faces his son]] In the present day, their plans were put into motion as a series of events that would lead Riku to become [[Ultraman Geed (character)|Ultraman Geed]]. As part of the operation to harvest the Ultra Capsules, Belial endowed Kei with his powers, allowing the latter to either summon Kaiju Capsules or transform into Belial Fusion Monsters in hopes of cementing Geed's role as the savior in the eyes of Little Star hosts. As a result of Kei's blunder for leaking out their operations, Belial forced him with the comeuppance of consuming all six Ultra Capsules he stole into his conversion organs. After escaping from his own pocket dimension, Belial kidnapped his son via Chimeraberus and departed towards the moon to absorb him using psychological means. As a result of Laiha and King's intervention, Geed escaped from Chimeraberus, dragging their battle towards Earth. Belial as Chimeraberus was destroyed for good when Geed assumes his Royal Megamaster form and fired his finisher, the Royal End. {{Storylink|The First Day of the End of the World}} {{Storylink|The King's Miracle! Time to Change Fate!!}} ====Endgame==== {{#tag: tabber| 1={{Quote|I am Ultraman Belial Atrocious. I was the one who nearly destroyed this universe. My body will soon obtain supreme power. To celebrate, I intend to blow your planet away, demonstrating my might to those fools in the Land of Light!|Belial's message to the people of Earth as Belial Atrocious.}} {{!}}-{{!}} 2={{Quote|GEED!!!!!|Belial's last word in his final moments.}} }} [[File:Belial_Outer_Earth.jpg|thumb|left|Belial Atrocious absorbing King's Childhood Radiation in space]] Belial was revealed to have survived his defeat as Chimeraberus and had taken [[Arie Ishikari]] as his host, explaining her interest in joining Kei and silently powering him with the ability to Fusion Rise. After Kei loses to Riku as Pedanium Zetton, Belial exposed his cover by tearing the alien's Sturm Organ and used it to revive himself. With his reclaimed Capsules, he assumed his new form, Belial Atrocious, to absorb King's [[Childhood Radiation]], simultaneously disrupting the balance of the universe. {{Storylink|The Sturm's Light}} Before departing towards the Land of Light, he decided to demonstrate his newfound powers on Earth by overwhelming Zero, Geed and Father of Ultra (the former two in their strongest forms), as well as killing [[Zegun]] after seeing through their plan to trap him in another dimension. {{Storylink|The Fragments of Hope}} [[File:HuggingHisDad.png|thumb|Riku, connecting to the Ultra inside Belial, forcing out Reiblood's influence]] However, thanks to Geed's determination and courage, Ultraman King's power granted Geed a miracle, which allowed his five forms to appear at the same time and fight Belial together. Using their combined finisher, Geed Proof, Geed destroyed the Giga Battlenizer and reverted Belial back to his normal form, before flying himself and Belial into the other dimension opened by Zegun. In a final clash, Riku and Belial fought in both body and spirit. While doing so, Belial's memories flowed into Riku, who understood his pain and suffering. Instead of continuing the fight, in the mental realm Riku had embraced Belial, and expelled Reiblood from his soul as Belial reverted back to his Early Style form. In the end, Belial and Geed had a beam clash, though Geed's Wrecking Burst won out and destroyed Belial's body, leaving his soul trapped in the other dimension. {{Storylink|The Symbol of Geed}} ===Ultraman R/B=== [[File:BelialandUltramanCrystal.jpeg|thumb|left]] The [[R／B Crystals|R/B Crystals]] of Ultraman and Belial was shown in the hands of [[Saki Mitsurugi]] before she gives it to [[Asahi Minato]]. Although Katsumi and Isami previously failed to harness the crystals' power while fighting [[Grigio|Grigio King]], they were able to do so during the rematch and transforming into [[Ultraman Ruebe]] via the Kiwami Crystal and easily defeated Grigio King. {{Storylink|Enshrined by Extremity}} ===Ultraman Taiga=== At some point after Belial's death, his genes were salvaged by the criminal organization [[Villain Guild]], where [[Alien Chibull]] [[Mabuze]] purchased it for his experiments of an ultimate life form. After using it to recreate [[Skull Gomora]], {{Storylink|I Can't Hear Your Voice}} Mabuze offers his service to a trio of alien, [[Alien Zarab]], [[Alien Sran]] and [[Alien Godola]] in order to defeat [[Ultraman Taiga (character)|Taiga]] and [[Ultraman Tregear|Tregear]]. The result was [[Imit-Ultraman Belial]], a mindless clone of the original with similar fighting prowess. {{Storylink|Clash! The original Belial is still deceased, but was present in the vision brought by Tartarus that chronicles his life conquest upon his banishment up to his death. ===Ultraman Z=== [[File:200725-3.jpg|thumb|left]] Due to his many battles and encounters, fragments of Belial, known as the Devil Splinters, were scattered across multiple dimensions, causing monsters to go berserk and rampage. The New Generation Heroes had been tasked with tracking down these fragments to stop any possible disasters from happening because of them. The Devil Splinters are also shown to be able to revive fallen beings, as seen when one lead to resurrection of [[Gillvalis]]. [[Celebro]] attempted to gather the Devil Splinters to create a Belial [[Kaiju Medals|Medal]], but was unsuccessful in his attempts until he captured Riku Asakura and used his Belial Factor instead. Doing so and combining it with other Kaiju Medals allowed Celebro to recreate the Belial Fusion Monsters. {{Storylink|The Man Returns!}} Though Belial remained deceased, his personality would undergo a sort of resurrection in the form of the [[Beliarok]], which gained Belial's likeness and mannerisms after it struck Ultraman Geed while he was trapped within the rift he created to temporarily seal [[Greeza]].{{Storylink|A Warrior's Duty}} ===Ultra Galaxy Fight: The Destined Crossroad=== {{Main|Ultraman Belial (Parallel Isotope)}} ==Personality== {{quote|Don't talk like you understand!|Belial denying Geed's words}} Belial's most notable personality traits are his greed and pride. He is unwilling to share power and will often kill or otherwise remove those who try to rule beside him. In fact, despite the importance of his army of monsters at his disposal, Belial has little to no concern for his henchmen and even betrays and murders a few of them just to convince Rei to join him. Ultimately, it can be said that Belial's principal desire is to become yet more powerful, and he is not above using his allies as stepping stones to achieve that goal, destroying or otherwise disposing of them when they are no longer of any use to him. However in ''Geed'', he seems to have a sense of recognition towards his own son despite the differences in their alignment in a similar way to most parents. Upon seeing into his mind during their final battle, Geed remarks that Belial is filled not only with rage over his banishment, but sorrow, implying that deep down Belial is saddened by his banishment but will never admit to it, nor the fact that his own actions caused it in the first place. Geed also states that Belial is fatigued by his countless resurrections but too consumed by his hatred to ever let go. Belial himself does not refute this idea and merely expressed rage at the idea Geed could ever understand his pain, despite the latter being his blood related child. ==Profile== As an Ultraman fused with [[Alien Reiblood]], Belial is extremely powerful and manipulative. He is able to defeat an army of Ultras without much effort and only [[Ultraman King]], Zero, and Geed (who is himself a clone of Belial) have been able to defeat him. Although Father of Ultra staggered Belial before he was hit in his wound. With the [[Giga Battlenizer]], he is able to control an army of monsters and channel his energy into attacks. Using Belial Virus energy through his claws, Belial can inject this into lifeforms and make them into his servants. Powered bonded with [[Kenichi Kai]] of [[WINR (Worldwide Investigation Network Response)|WINR]] to defend the Earth against the [[Alien Baltan|Baltans]] as well as other monsters and aliens that threaten humanity. ==Conception== ===Design=== Powered's coloring is based on the original Ultraman and new details were added in the design process. In order to express unevenness of a delicate line, the suit was made entirely with clay during the prototype stage and was molded by die-cutting the foam rubber. While it can create a realistic look when used in the making of superhero suits, foam rubber is very easy to tear while being worn. This meant that a new suit had to be prepared for each new shot. In the majority of the Ultra series, Ultraman's mask is joined with the suit, but in the making of the Powered Suit it was decided to allow the mask to detach itself when needed. In various Japanese magazine media, attraction shows, and subsequent theatrical versions, costumes using wet suits made by Rice Production were used. Undulations of the chest and shoulder lines were major feature of the Powered suit, with the knee parts represented by stacking of the fabric. The lights in Ultraman's eyes are blue. They were supposed to be white like all the other Ultra suits, but this was changed at the very last second to make this suit unique to the American production. ==History== ===Ultraman: The Ultimate Hero=== [[File:Powered 1993 01.png|left|thumb|Ultraman Powered's first appearance.]] Ultraman Powered was on a mission to bring down the [[Alien Baltan|Baltans]], an empire that brought death and destruction to countless worlds. Soon his hunt came to Earth, where he proved to be unable to survive without a human host. Choosing a suitable host, the young member of [[WINR (Worldwide Investigation Network Response)|WINR]], [[Kenichi Kai]], Ultraman Powered brought the fight to the giant Baltan rampaging through the city. The fight was fast and brief, but brutal, as the two knocked one another across the streets and into the buildings around them. As the other members of WINR watched on, the fight took to the sky and then back to the streets, where Baltan tried its best to bring down Powered. But the hero would not fail and launched the Mega Spacium Beam, a weapon so powerful it completely vaporized the Baltan. {{Storylink|On a Mission from M78}} [[File:Powered 1993 02.png|left|thumb|Ultraman Powered vs [[Telesdon|Powered Telesdon]].]] While this threat was over, the mission of protecting Earth had just begun. While the Baltans retreated and re-planned, more monsters, some native and others alien to the Earth, began to rise. But as his adventures continued on, the Baltans soon returned. Watching over every battle with cruel eyes, they created a monster, [[Dorako]], designed to dissect Powered. The monster not only handed Ultraman his first defeat, but threatened millions of lives. As the winged creature rampaged, Kai again summoned Powered, but ultimately, it was a battle that would permanently end their bond. {{Storylink|Falling Stars Spell Trouble}} Dorako’s sharp blade cut through Powered's chest, and while ultimately the hero managed to kill the fiend, something unexpected had happened: Kai also felt the wound and pain! [[SSSP (ULTRAMAN)|SSSP]] |Portrayed by = }} {{Nihongo|'''Kotaro Higashi'''|東 光太郎|Higashi Kōtarō}} is a supporting character in the ''[[ULTRAMAN (2011 manga)|ULTRAMAN]]'' manga series. He is a Japanese photographer who gained superpowers after a run-in with aliens, and becomes a hero known as '''Taro'''. He was later given the Taro Suit after allying himself with the [[SSSP (ULTRAMAN)|SSSP]]. ==History== Kotaro was a reporter from Japan with an interest in revealing the truth, no matter the cost. He traveled to America to investigate a bank robbery perpetrated by a pair of cloaked beings with glowing eyes. When his colleague [[David Loomis|Dave]] pointed out the pointlessness of it, Kotaro went on his own way. [[File:ULTRAMAN Kotaro Drug Rebirth.png|thumb|left|200px|Kotaro, cheering after his "rebirth".]] The reporter later came across an odd exchange in an alleyway, where two men appeared to be arguing. One fled when Kotaro discovered a mysterious vial, while the second man's eye begins to glow and he punched through Kotaro's stomach before fleeing. However, the reporter miraculously survived the assault and lay on the street cheering. Kotaro finds he is surrounded by several broken, mysterious vials and decides to investigate. After replacing his blood-soaked shirt, Kotaro comes across a woman and a purse-snatcher. With incredible speed, Kotaro catches up and jumps over the purse-snatcher, who is shocked and flees without the purse. Kotaro is called a hero by the woman and inspired by this, Kotaro returns to Dave's with rolls of fabric with him, deciding to become a superhero. With Dave's help, Kotaro tests his abilities and finds out that along with super speed and agility, he has super strength but the two flee after encountering a police car. Kotaro recounts his encounter with the alien and ponders if the drug in the vials gave him these abilities. He shows Dave the drawing of his own Ultraman suit and reveals he added horns to it because it looked cooler. As 'Ultraman', Kotaro helps prevent a robber from escaping. He then helps the police capture a human under the effects of the mysterious drug and leaves to have Dave help cool him off due to the fact that using his powers causes his body to produce steam and increases his body temperature. After saving a group of hostages, Kotaro returned to Dave but is confronted by a [[Dark Star Drugs|group of drug-powered humans]] and [[Alien Dorzu|Alien Druz]] who had Dave captured. After discovering that Kotaro isn't Ultraman, Alien Druz revealed to him that his existence had 'thrown a wrench' in the Dark Star's plans. When Kotaro tried to save Dave, he is knocked down and Alien Druz killed Dave. Enraged, Kotaro erupted in a blast of flames as he manifests as a flame-like entity, killing Alien Druz and his lackeys. Kotaro awakens in his bed, having been saved by [[Agent Adad|Adad]] and Red, the latter two reveal what happened. After watching the Star of Darkness' reveal, Kotaro decides to help the two in order to protect everyone. Kotaro reveals to the two that in Japanese, his name contains the character for 'Light' (光) and he believes he doesn't deserve it, asking them to refer to him as Taro. Kotaro, Red and Adad joined the battle against the the [[Star of Darkness]], taking on the footsoldiers, but soon found themselves overwhelmed by the [[Golden Fortress]]. Fortunately, [[Dan Moroboshi (ULTRAMAN)|Moroboshi]] arrived with new weapons and single-handedly destoyed the giant robot, leaving them and the other Ultramen to fight against the Star of Darkness' members. Kotaro handled the footsoldiers. At the climax of the battle, [[Shin Hayata (ULTRAMAN)|Shin]], [[Shinjiro Hayata|Shinjiro]] and [[Bemular (ULTRAMAN)|Bemular]] fired their Spacium Beams at [[Alien Pedan (ULTRAMAN)|Alien Pedan]], the leader of the Star of Darkness, and destroyed most of his body. All that was left was half of his face, still alive and talking about how justice was theirs. Taro disagreed, burning away the remains to ash. After the battle of New York, Kotaro joined the American branch of the [[SSSP (ULTRAMAN)|SSSP]] and visited Dave's grave, grieving for his deceased friends. Kotaro was contacted by Jack to investigate a case, and learned that after the [[Star Cluster Alliance]] publicly announced their plans to the people of Earth, tensions between human and alien populations were reaching their breaking point and both sides were committing atrocities to themselves and to each other. [[File:ULTRAMAN Taro confronting Valky.png|thumb|200px|Confronting Valky for the first time.]] Kotaro tracked down a group of disgruntled aliens, tired of living under the shadow of "inferior" humans, led by [[Alien Valky (ULTRAMAN)|Valky]] to go on a killing spree. Using the [[Ultraman Suit|Taro Suit]], newly built for him by [[Yapool (ULTRAMAN)|Yapool]] to control his powers, Kotaro confronted the group and killed one of them before the others retreated. Valky then challenged Taro to a battle for ruining her business, and the two came to a stalemate. During their conversation, Kotaro declared no matter what happens and whoever he is facing, he will always fight for the weak and defenseless. These worlds impressed Valky. She called off the fight and kissed the former, stating if she had a choice, so would she. After this footage was revealed to the rest of the SSSP, Kotaro was utterly embarrassed. Kotaro later encountered Valky again, who warned him that his actions would make him an enemy to the Star Cluster Council, but he rebutted her by saying that it was only natural for him to protect lives. He was then dispatched to help [[Seiji Hokuto (ULTRAMAN)|Seiji]] fight against three [[Alien Zarab|alien]] [[Alien Adacic|impostors]] disguised as Shinjiro, Dan, and Shin, while the real trio was restrained by a paranoid [[Ambassador Mephisto]], in a desperate attempt to tarnish the reputation of Ultraman. [[File:ULTRAMAN Eyeslugger combined.png|thumb|left|200px]] The two were quickly overwhelmed by the imposters, who cockily mocked humanity and Ultraman as they took a woman hostage. They soon received reinforcement from the [[Leo Brothers (ULTRAMAN)|Leo Brothers]], but the two were unwilling to rescue the hostage. Fortunately for them, with the arrival of Bemular and Adad to rescue the hostage, as well as the captured Ultraman trio freed by Edo and [[Windom (ULTRAMAN)|Windom]] joining the battle, the tide was turned. When Dan saw the known gigantic Alien Adacic wearing armor similar to his, he asked Kotaro if he was imposed by the latter, who addressed the alien as an "irritating bastard." After the battle, he and Jack received a mission from the United States. After the battle against [[Beacon|a three-eyed creature]], they realize Ultraman is no longer welcome. However, when Jack was forced to execute a rampaging alien named Fred, whose wife was killed by xenophobic humans, they soon received massive applause, much to his outrage, and he started to yell at the crowd. They later came to Detroit, where Adad was trying to reason with a group of human mobs on the conflicts between them and aliens. Suddenly, the ex-agent was [[Ace Killer (ULTRAMAN)|shot]] in the back and killed, as they moaned for their fallen comrade, they were joined by several human children, which also influenced the adult bystanders. This made them regain faith in humanity. [[File:ULTRAMAN Taro vs Tyrant.png|thumb|200px|Taro battling against Tyrant]] The two Ultraman were soon attacked by the Zetton Core warrior Tyrant, but Jack was able to finish him off with his new weapon, the Ultra Axe.
